digest.component_or_area: completion verifier / LLM structured output extraction
propositions: Completion verifier returns a DEPENDENCY-LINK record where CompletionVerdict is required, blocking ticket close despite a valid verdict being present in the reply

Root cause: parse_structured via tolerant_parse selects the first parseable JSON object (schema-blind) instead of the first object satisfying the target schema, when a Dep record is quoted in prose before the verdict

Selection policy is deliberate and shared across all LLM gates (plan-review, overlap, epic-bug-screen), so fix requires coordinated change to extraction AND directive, plus schema-aware filtering for all-defaults contracts

Multi-layer permanent fix: (1) provider-native output where viable (Bedrock sonnet/haiku with measured bounds handling), (2) sentinel channel + schema-filtered last-valid-wins selection + deprecation of first-wins, (3) property test invariant + corpus of real replies including df3a, (4) raw-reply artifact on parse failure for diagnostics

Current mitigation scope does not fit the defect: mechanical wiring fix does not apply because selection policy is deliberate, shared, and requires atomic directive+extraction change across verification gates
